title: Grating Equation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly apply the grating equation d sin(theta) = k lambda.

title: Wavelength Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Calculate the wavelengths for k values that yield visible light.

title: Color Identification
description: Important Criteria: Identify the correct colors corresponding to the calculated wavelengths.

title: Correct d Value
description: Important Criteria: Use the correct value for d derived from the grating lines per mm.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure all wavelengths are reported in consistent units (Ångströms).

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid sign mistakes in the application of the grating equation.

title: Missing Wavelengths
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure all possible wavelengths for k values are calculated and reported.
